objective: Discover a useful public JSON API from a machine-readable public API directory without a host-selected provider, read and interpret its OpenAPI contract, determine whether an unauthenticated read-only GET operation is available, materialize a fresh bounded adapter, verify it, perform a real live request, parse returned data, and register the evidence-backed integration as a shadow capability.
host_role: supply public catalog, bounded safety policy, trigger, transport and verification only; do not select provider, API, endpoint or adapter source
kernel_role: rank catalog entries, fetch candidate OpenAPI contracts, reject authenticated or mutating operations, select provider and endpoint, derive semantic IR, materialize adapter source, verify, connect, parse and register evidence
